title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 4
paragraphs: When Mardonius had reached Athens, he sent Morychides, a man of the Hellespont, to Salamis, bearing the same proposals Alexander the Macedonian had brought over to the Athenians. He sent them a second time, being aware beforehand that the Athenians' disposition was not friendly, but hoping they would give way and abandon their obstinacy, since the Attic land had been captured by the enemy and was in his power.
